integrity: The two complete standalone scripts are supplied; exhaustive exact-cover enumeration and the S9/AGL(2,3) coset computation agree, using integer-only operations.
scientific_limitations: A complete finite classification for labelled order-nine designs under simultaneous six-block trades only; no generalization to higher orders or arbitrary trade sizes. A relevant Griggs–Rosa (2003) chapter was not available in full, leaving publication-priority uncertainty. Independent scholarly audit has not been performed.
source_ids: Cameron, A Markov chain for Steiner triple systems (2002)
Forbes-Grannell-Griggs, Distance and fractional isomorphism in Steiner triple systems (2006 preprint)
Forbes, Configurations and colouring problems in block designs (2006 dissertation)

title: Minimum six-block trades among labelled Steiner triple systems of order nine
